verdicts.reason: A breaks the three flavour pills apart: Cucumber Mint floats above the headline, Blood Orange sits off-axis beside the CTA, and Honey Rosemary is stranded near the bottom. The SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, and the centred CTA clashes with the left-aligned text. B keeps the pills together, but squeezes them into a wrapped, out-of-order cluster on top of the decorative circle in the corner. It leaves a large empty band in the middle, also moves SOLSTICE below the headline, and jams the centred CTA against the subcopy. Both need rework; B is slightly less broken because its pills stay grouped and its headline reads in one line.
